review_instruction: Finding a real issue is a successful review. Judge every full-resolution image critically; structural counters cannot overrule visible evidence.

dispositions.notes: Every visible room is roof-closed and the silhouette is taller, but the overall mass reads as an elongated chain more than a compact warren.
The reverse overview verifies varied, complete roofs and no visually short/wide house envelope.
Authored plank surfaces remain consistently light and the section has several occupied height bands.
The entry turns past a stocked market and does not expose a straight street through the town.
The hostile camera missed the intended interior ground route and mostly tests the exterior silhouette.
The cross-town camera is outside the occupied fabric, so it cannot falsify the internal ground maze.
Connected plank surfaces pass entrances, change elevation, and remain bounded by nearby facades.
The occupied overhead connection reads as building mass rather than a bare bridge.
A long grass-floored undercroft extends beneath the shaft-closing deck network and reaches visible exterior daylight through the town.
All visible generated rooms, bays, and corner overlaps have complete integrated roofs.
The former multi-column vertical shaft is covered, but the cure is still a broad pale deck lattice with too little occupied mass beneath it.

findings.evidence: Nine platform-infill patches, eight required by the shaft metric, form a continuous low ceiling over an open grass lawn. The horizon remains visible beneath the fabric.
findings.invariant: A shaft-closing upper surface is admissible only where its lower volume is already bounded urban space; it must not manufacture a substantial uninhabited suspended platform.

findings.evidence: Both new cross-town cameras have zero target visibility and sit outside the route volume.
findings.invariant: Hostile sightline cameras must be derived from public-route cells and look along an internal route chord, with validated target visibility.

findings.evidence: The mass is vertically varied but has a long-chain footprint from the north-east overview.
findings.invariant: The selected construction should be compact in both horizontal axes, with branches folding back through the same central mass.
